verification: Primary paper abstract pages and the PyTorch 2.3 torch.stft API page were opened and checked on the web. Paper titles and model ideas are cited; no pretrained weights or official implementation code are downloaded.
implementation_policy: All benchmark models are local from-scratch implementations. Paper-inspired classifiers are adaptations with differences explicitly recorded in bench/models.py MODEL_INFO and MODEL_NOTES.txt. This file does not establish equivalence to original-paper experiments.

vgg.title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
vgg.relevant_idea: Deep stacks of small convolution kernels; the benchmark converts the visual architecture to the project's 1D classification design.

resnet.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
resnet.relevant_idea: Residual basic blocks; benchmark uses 1D and small-spectrogram adaptations of the 18-layer topology.

inceptiontime.title: InceptionTime: Finding AlexNet for Time Series Classification
inceptiontime.relevant_idea: Multi-scale inception modules and residual grouping for time-series classification. The benchmark is a single network, not the paper's ensemble.

tcn.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling
tcn.relevant_idea: Dilated causal residual convolutions. The benchmark uses a pooled binary head and omits weight normalization.

gru.title: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
gru.relevant_idea: Gated recurrent unit. The benchmark uses PyTorch's bidirectional GRU as a local window classifier rather than the paper's encoder-decoder.

transformer.title: Attention Is All You Need
transformer.relevant_idea: Multi-head attention and transformer encoder blocks. Local models use learned positions and classification heads rather than the translation encoder-decoder.

patchtst.title: A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers
patchtst.relevant_idea: Patches and channel independence with shared embedding/encoder weights. Benchmark replaces forecasting with a binary classification head and omits RevIN and pretraining.

vit.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
vit.relevant_idea: Image patch tokens and a class token. Benchmark is a compact four-channel STFT classifier, not the original ViT sizes or pretrained model.

torch_stft.title: torch.stft — PyTorch 2.3 documentation
torch_stft.relevant_idea: STFT API and Hann-window/centering options. Exact frontend settings are recorded in models.STFTLogPower; no bandpass filter is applied.

local_baselines.mlp: A simple dense control baseline specified locally, without an official-paper reproduction claim.
local_baselines.cnn1d: A simple three-block convolutional control baseline specified locally, without an official-paper reproduction claim.
local_baselines.vgg16_1d: The project's 0-VGG19MLP.ipynb, cell 7 (zero-based), supplies the 1D VGG feature configuration and 1024/512 binary-head precedent. Benchmark construction initializes fresh parameters and does not load the historical checkpoint.
